# Vendored libraries

Served from this folder, never from a CDN. Each file is the published build, unmodified; its licence sits next to it.

| File | Library | Version | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `htmx.min.js` | htmx | 2.0.4 | 0BSD, `htmx-LICENSE.txt` | https://unpkg.com/htmx.org@2.0.4/dist/htmx.min.js |
| `zxing.min.js` | @zxing/library | 0.20.0 | Apache-2.0, `zxing-LICENSE.txt` | https://unpkg.com/@zxing/library@0.20.0/umd/index.min.js |
| `jsbarcode.min.js` | JsBarcode | 3.11.6 | MIT, `jsbarcode-LICENSE.txt` | https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode/releases/tag/v3.11.6 |
| `atkinson/*.woff2` | Atkinson Hyperlegible | — | SIL OFL 1.1, `atkinson/OFL.txt` | Braille Institute of America |

To upgrade one, replace the file with the published build, update this table and the licence file, and check the screens that use it.
